title: Cipla Ltd Gross Margin Analysis Shows No Company Specific Deviation Against Listed Peers
abstract: This research note examines the gross margin of pharmaceutical manufacturer Cipla Ltd compared against five listed peers as of 20 October 2026. We examined nine quarters of filed results to assess the company performance. The main finding is that the company change was within 1.6 robust standard deviations of the peer median, which is too close to call company-specific. Revenue from operations in Q3 FY25 was Rs 7,073.0 crore, compared to Rs 6,603.8 crore a year earlier in Q3 FY24. Additional data show that revenue from operations rose from Rs 5,739.3 crore in Q4 FY23 to Rs 7,073.0 crore in Q3 FY25. The gross margin changepoint in Q3 FY24 reflects cost pressures affecting the gross margin metric. This change has held for 5 quarters against an earlier average of 64.3 per cent. The finding would be undermined if net profit margin falls to or below 0.0 per cent for 2 consecutive quarters, with the next test expected around 13 February 2027.
introduction: Cipla Ltd is a pharmaceutical manufacturer listed on the National Stock Exchange of India, as of 20 October 2026. This note focuses on gross margin, compared against 5 listed peers.

findings: The company's change was within 1.6 robust standard deviations of the peer median, which is too close to call company-specific.

The company moved 3.7 robust standard deviations away from the median of 4 peers, so the change is specific to it. The change has held for 7 quarters against an earlier average of 11.4 per cent.

The gross margin changepoint in Q3FY24 reflects cost pressures affecting the gross margin metric: rejected. The company's change was within 1.6 robust standard deviations of the peer median, which is too close to call company-specific. The change has held for 5 quarters against an earlier average of 64.3 per cent. Table 3 notes that the surviving explanation held against every check applied to its strongest rivals.
outlook: The finding would be undermined if net profit margin falls to or below 0.0 per cent for 2 consecutive quarters. The next test is Cipla Ltd.'s next quarterly results, expected around 13 February 2027.
conclusion: Our examination of the filed results for Cipla Ltd indicates that gross margin movements remain within expected peer parameters. The evaluation confirms that the observed change is too close to call company-specific against the analysed peer group.
